title.narrative: Sustainability of services for key populations in South East Asia region - Asia - Multicountry HIV SEA AFAO (01-Jul-2022-31-Dec-2025)

description.narrative: Multicountry HIV SEA AFAO, HIV, Australian Federation Of AIDS Organisations Limited (AFAO)This program has the following goals: Improved sustainability of evidence-informed prioritized HIV services for key populations and people living with HIV in Bhutan, Mongolia, the Philippines and Sri Lanka. The objectives of this program are: Accelerating financial sustainability. Improving strategic information availability and use. Promoting programmatic sustainability. Removing human rights and gender-related barriers to services
